title: Product Bundle Photos for Clearer Listings | AIVideosUGC
description: Show every item in your kit in one square bundle photo. Use it on Amazon, Shopify, gift pages, social ads and posts without another styled shoot.
h1: Product Bundle Photos for Items Sold Together
lead: Bundle shoppers want one clear answer: what exactly comes in the box? Upload a photo of the complete kit and get a bundle image that lets buyers count the pieces before ordering.
benefits_h2: Product bundle photos that answer buyer questions

benefits.t: Answer "what do I get" at a glance
benefits.d: One square image shows every piece and nothing extra, so shoppers can count the kit without opening a dropdown. The contents question is settled before they read the description.

benefits.t: No styled shoot for each gift set
benefits.d: Arrange a starter kit, refill pack or holiday gift set in a clean scene from one source photo. Seasonal styling is added without booking a product photographer.
Upload every shipped piece, including the box and inserts, and state the exact count. The image supports your written contents list instead of inventing missing accessories.

benefits.t: Ready for listings and gift pages
benefits.d: Place the square photo as image two on Amazon or Shopify and use it in seasonal gift posts. Downloads carry no AIVideosUGC watermark and can be used commercially.

faq.q: What is a product bundle photo template?
faq.a: It is a ready-made set scene. Add one photo of your kit and generate a clear image that shows what ships together.

faq.q: Do I need to write prompts to use these templates?
faq.a: No. Pick a bundle style, upload your kit photo and generate. Step two can include one short line about the arrangement if you want.

faq.q: Who are bundle templates built for?
faq.a: Ecommerce sellers, gift brands and agencies that need a clean contents view for listings, bundles and ads.

faq.q: Can one photo show every item in my kit?
faq.a: Yes. Start with a photo where each piece is visible and the full set fits in the frame.

faq.q: Can I add the bundle price to the photo?
faq.a: Add the current price, offer or contents text as an editable layer in your editor after download.

faq.q: Can I show the bundle on a white background?
faq.a: Yes. Choose a clean product scene when a white or light backdrop matches your listing style.

faq.q: How fast is a bundle photo made?
faq.a: A photo is generated in minutes after you start the job, with no props to buy or second shoot.

faq.q: What does a bundle photo cost?
faq.a: Each photo costs 24 credits, and the charge is shown before the job starts.

faq.q: Can I use the bundle image in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no AIVideosUGC watermark and can run in your own ads, pages and posts. You remain responsible for contents and claims.
